claim: A fresh graph can identify factorized opaque effectors, synthesize simultaneous wheeled/aerodynamic motor programs without a Cartesian action lattice, detect a hidden complete surface failure from changed receipts, and rebuild the program from surviving groups.

plant.aerodynamic_model: flow-squared external force at four body-relative application points with drag and actuator-energy receipts
plant.qualification: research plant, not a CFD or vehicle-certification model

refusals: No semantic actuator label may enter a graph model.
Python may translate and validate tokens but may not choose program members.
The result does not establish lap-time superiority, high-fidelity aerodynamics, or hardware safety.
